148527.overview: Al*berthe is a variant of the arcade game Q*bert. The game plays largely the same as the original albeit here only the top side of each cube is rendered. The player controls a young girl who has to jump from platform to platform so that all of them change colour. In the first level, each platform has to be jumped on once, while in the second two moves over each is needed. In the third one, only one move is required but making a second move will transform it back to its original state. At the same time, the player has to avoid three different enemies since any contact with them will lead to a lost life. There is a ball and a snake jumping between the platforms as well as a bird that flies across the screen.
